began.says: The moment it began, as the log writes one, so since() finds what it wrote.

ended.says: The moment it closed, everything in the field and committed; absent while it runs.

purpose.says: What it set out to do, in the session's words.

said.says: The utterances of its session it spans, the author's and the session's.

step.says: What of the plan it took up, in a few words.

body.purpose: Begin the governed way of working, since() and threads raised by any voice, and build one act, one commit in glass's own format, attacked and read by Fable, the wiki tended.
The engine with no store of its own, writing each holon where it is kept; and what waits on the author made a thing of the field, awaiting() and the Thread component, the wiki tended.
Every store given its root, its shape and the stores it stands on, the top seen three ways, read by Fable and mended.
The author's words and the sessions taken out of the main store into the author's own, with their history whole; and cycles made things of the field.

body.says: One session of work with the author: when it ran, what it stood beside, the words it received in order, and the paths of evolution it noted.

beside.says: What ran beside it, as the arity of sessions grows: a note in words until that session is a holon to point at.

condensations.says: What stands for its utterances in fewer words, held as its own.

cycles.says: Its cycles, in order: each a stretch of work that ends with everything in the field and committed.

ended.says: How its end was declared, where it was declared: a session is ended by being said to end.

forkedAt.says: The utterance of that session at which it was forked.

forkedFrom.says: For a session forked from another: the session it was forked from.

kept.says: How much of it was kept, where not all of it was.

notes.says: Holons it wrote that stand on their own and that it points at, such as a licence reading.

paths.says: Paths of evolution the session noted, in the order noted.

said.says: The author's utterances, in the order they came.

sent.says: The messages it sent to other sessions, where their timelines meet: held as its own.

sources.says: The sources it read from outside the field, held as its own.

voice.says: The voice it answered in, held as its own.

body.kept: Whole in the author's words: every utterance as it came, typed or spoken, the session's reading which; the typing's slips corrected on the word. His direction, written under the rule for another project and pasted here, kept as he gave it. After each, the essence of the session's answer in its own voice. The work stands in cfde5be, How the code is written; 8389ebb, the code made modules at the root with each store moved whole; ef74b65, the components made again from the root; and in the store's own commits.

name: A tenth session, kept whole: how the code is written, and the code made modules at the root
